header.title: Create a shipment
header.description: A guided flow that only offers routes, companies, and services that are actually available.

route.title: Where is the parcel coming from and going to?
route.description: Only countries served by an operational company are loaded. Cities appear after selecting a country.
route.noCity: No served city is available in this country.

service.title: Choose the delivery network
service.description: Results are calculated from the selected route, in the expected order.
service.noTransport: No transport mode covers this route.
service.noCompany: No company is eligible for this route and mode.

parcel.title: Define the parcel and service level
parcel.description: Available parcel types come from the selected company’s pricing.
parcel.pointsHint: Choose a parcel type to load compatible points.
parcel.photosDescription: Add up to 4 photos. Image formats only.
parcel.noParcelType: This company has no priced parcel type.
parcel.noPoints: No point is compatible with this selection.

people.title: Who is sending and receiving?
people.description: The recipient can be linked to their SENDAMhub account or entered manually.

review.title: Review before creating
review.description: The backend calculates the price from this selection.
review.collectionPointPlan: The client first pays the platform fee online. The collector then collects the company price during physical reception.
review.platformPlan: The client pays the full company price and platform fee online from the client application.
review.simulationStale: Some information changed. Recalculate the price before confirming.

errors.metadata: Unable to load the data required to create a shipment.
errors.transportModes: Unable to load available transport modes.
errors.userSearch: Unable to search for this user.
errors.simulation: Unable to calculate this shipment price.
errors.serviceRequired: Select the transport mode and company.
errors.parcelRequired: Complete the parcel information and points.
errors.peopleRequired: Complete the sender and recipient information.
errors.positiveNumber: The value must be a positive number.
errors.photoLimit: You can add no more than 4 photos.
